thread:
ida: Heads-up — release window in 30m. CI is stuck on the final artifact manifest upload for staging (job: release-artifact-upload). Deploy-scheduler shows a stale cached manifest and the promotion is blocked. Holding promotion until we confirm artifacts.

sam: Ugh. Any error lines from the runner?

ida: Logs from the runner:
```
Uploading manifest to s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/manifest-rc.json
PUT /manifest 202 Accepted
Background blob upload started, waiting for commit
... no progress for 3m, TCP retransmit spikes
agent: retrying upload (attempt 4) -> 429 Too Many Requests from storage-proxy
```
Seems like the storage-proxy started rate-limiting the manifest commit.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler attempted automatic reupload x3 between 1745628200-1745628300; all attempts returned 429/504. Promotion automatically paused. See /deploy/logs/1745628.

cheng: Is this the same storage-proxy region that had the cache-throttle last week? Could be a transient S3 gateway issue. We should either reupload the manifest from a different runner or fall back to promoting last-good digest.

marta: Are there DB migrations in this release? If we promote previous digest we'll avoid applying new migrations accidentally.

ida: No DB migrations in this RC, it's a service-only change (model routing + small perf tweak). Safe to promote previous image for the release window.

sam: Proposed options: 1) wait for storage-proxy to recover and retry upload (risk: miss change window). 2) re-run artifact-upload on a different runner/region. 3) promote previous good image/digest and continue rollout, then re-run patch release later.

cheng: I can run a manual promote to the rc tag. The last-good digest is `sha256:4f3b9a2c7d9e`. Command: `deployctl promote --image sha256:4f3b9a2c7d9e --tag rc-20240215 --reason \"artifact upload stalled\"`

ida: That sounds right. We should also flag this in release notes: \"Promoted last-good artifact due to upstream artifact storage throttling; remaining changes will be reattempted in a follow-up canary.\"

marta: +1, we should annotate the rollout in the console and lock the config so CI doesn't auto-promote once artifact upload recovers. Also add a rollback playbook entry in the release notes in case anomalies show up.

deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollouts are suspended for this release tag until manual-unpause. Manual promotion will set `release.state=manual` and annotate with `artifact-fallback`.

ida: Who will run the promote? I can approve but need @cheng to execute (he's oncall for infra). If @cheng can't, @sam will take it.

cheng: Running it now.

cheng: Ran `deployctl promote ...` -> response: `202 Accepted, promotion queued`, console shows rc-20240215 -> sha256:4f3b9a2c7d9e promoted to staging.

oncall-bot: [incident tracker] Created INC-2024-58: "artifact storage throttling causing manifest commit failures" assigned to infra-team. Priority P2.

ida: Thanks. OK to unhold promotion for the release window? If so we should note follow-up tasks: (A) re-attempt artifact upload + reconcile manifest blob records, (B) check if any customers hit unexpected behavior, (C) add storage-proxy rate-limit telemetry alert.

sam: I'm fine unholding. We should schedule the reupload in a nightly patch job and ensure a checksum verification step before closing INC.

marta: I'll add the follow-ups to the release notes and ping support to monitor for regressions. Also set a 2-hour watch on console metrics for the rollout.

ida: Unholding now. Promotion resumed at 1745628700. Please monitor latency and error budgets.

cheng: Confirmed: promotion resumed, canaries started. Patch re-upload job queued for 02:00 UTC. I'll follow up on INC-2024-58.

sam: :thumbsup: Good call to pin. If storage-proxy clears quickly we can roll the new artifacts in a patch without customer-visible impact.

ida: Closing thread for the window. Notes: promoted last-good digest `sha256:4f3b9a2c7d9e`, created INC-2024-58, follow-up reupload scheduled. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
